name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD (v3): 0.5.1's second reinitCertVerifier() call, placed immediately before the retry send, was found (production log: 5 consecutive cycles, every retry failing with the identical finishCryptoEncapsulation error) to reliably break that same send -- a cold, just-rebuilt CertVerifier can't complete the sender's own synchronous cert verification during the send. Removed. Replaced with a delayed (5s, user-suggested) reinitCertVerifier() that runs after any *successful* send (first attempt or retry) instead of before one, doing nothing else (no doCleanup(), no cert9.db read) -- proactively keeps the next read clean without ever interfering with an in-flight crypto operation.
